blocks.text: The basic element of a DC circuit is a resistor R, which controls the current or voltage, with V = IR (Ohm's law). The basic elements of AC circuits are the resistor R, the inductor L and the capacitor C, which together control the current and voltage. AC circuits containing these components are discussed in the following sections: a resistor (17.5), an inductor (17.6 and 17.7) and a capacitor (17.8), followed by impedance (17.9) and combinations of them (17.10 to 17.13).
